full_judgment:
50. The facts relating for disposal of these two appeal, are that Dhaka Improvement Trust, shortly DIT, at present Rajdhani Unnayan Kartripakkha shortly RAJUK, allotted the plot which was the subject matter of Appeal From Original Decree No. 357 of 2009, to the father of the plaintiffs, Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of Bara Mogbazar. Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza was born in India, passed matriculation in 1944, Intermediate in 1946 from Islamia College, Kolkata, civil engineering in 1950 from University of Calcutta and working in India as site engineer for 2 years and came to the then East Pakistan and joined C&B Department as Assistant Engineer, later on, he was promoted Executive Engineer, later on, he abandoned that post and joined as Senior Consultant of Eastern Housing Ltd, purchased 10 kathas of land by registered deed dated 28-9-1957 at 157 Baro Moghbazar, Dhaka and by registered heba deed dated 17-8-1979 gifted the said land to his wife, Selima Begum and after getting plan approved from RAJUK, constructed 3-storied building and resides there till his death on 2-2-2004. He used his address in official and non-official documents as 157, Baro Moghbazar. Before he joined Eastern Housing Ltd, while he was in service at C&B department, he went to Canada for higher training and thereafter, returned and joined C&B as Executive Engineer. DIT allotted the plot for 99 years vide allotment letter under memo No. 2409 dated 21-3-1962. He paid money settled by DIT for the aforesaid plot by five installments dated 26-3-1962, 26-6-1962, 7-1-1963, 5-3-1964 and 3-2-1966 and got receipts. DTI delivered possession of the suit plot to the father of the plaintiffs on 1-8-1962 and after getting plot, he constructed a pucca boundary wall and erected a katcha construction and posted a care taker to main-tain his possession. DIT as lessor gave registered lease deed after filling up the printed form on 1-8-1962 to the father of the plaintiff and another copy was retained by DIT at serial Nos. 7848 and 7849 it was registered in the concern registry office under registered No. 7198, and thereafter original lease deed was delivered to the plaintiff. The father of the plaintiffs worked in C&13 department and thereafter, in 1964 he joined one of the sister concern of Islam Group i.e. Bengal Development Corporation, shortly BDC, as director. The father of the plaintiffs got plot from DIT and wanted to construct a 6-storied building of 8,000 square feet on each floor after taking loan from House Building Finance Corporation by mortgaging the suit plot on 17-5-1967. The father of the plaintiffs constructed, as per plan, first floor and opened holding in the Dhaka municipality, mutated his name with the revenue office, took WASA, electricity and gas connection in his name from different departments of the government and regularly paid tax, rents and bills. He rented the building to Agency for International Development, Mr. D Markiing and A Lippene Otto, Mr. LLoye F Gonyea, Mr. MM Abouzeid of United Nations Development Programme, Mr. Fred HW Petrini of Swedish International Service, Dr. Martin W Bloem of Helen Keller International, Uttara Bank Ltd and Altab Multipurpose firm Ltd. The suit plot having been on the road side of Gulshan Avenue, the father of the plaintiffs for constructing a multistoried commercial buil-ding given power of attorney to Eastern Housing Ltd. who filed application for conversation of the plot from residential to commercial plot on 30-1-2001 and RAJUK after taking conversion fees of Tk. 38,28,125 by letter dated 14-8-2001, converted the plot to commercial plot and for constructing a multi-storied building, the father of the plaintiff gave power of attorney, which was registered bearing No. 15902 dated 21-12-2003 to Eastern Housing Ltd and the said power of attorney was deposited in the office of RAJUK for approval and the same was approved by RAJUK. After Aftab multipurpose firm leave possession of the plot, Eastern Housing Ltd. passed a plan on 8-2-2003 on the basis of power of attorney, for constructing a 6 storied building from the RAJUK and dismantle one storied building and construction was about to be started, heard that MA Hashem, defendant No. 1, manufactured and created a false fabricated bainanama through a fictitious the person claiming to be Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza resides at house No.31, lane No.02, Section 6/A, Mirpur, Dhaka. The father of the plaintiffs got that news and published notifications in daily Jonakantha, lttegaq, Observer, lnquilab and Prothamalo on 18-11-2003 against which defendant No.1, MA Hashem about one month thereafter on 10-12-2003 published objection notification stating that Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of Mirpur, defendant No.2, is the real and original allottee with whom he entered into an agreement i.e. bainanama on 29-12-2002 by this the father of the plaintiffs became astonished and was surprised and with the original papers and documents relating to the suit property, went to defendant No.1 at his office at Sena Kollyan Bhaban, Motijheel and tried to convince that Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of Mirpur is a fictitious person. In the objection notification his father's name was given late Md. Hosen but the father's name of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza is Md. Yiadul Hossain of which MA Hashem disclosed and gave assurance that he will never demand the suit property on the basis of bainanama with Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of Mirpur. But he was surprised to find that MA Hashem on 11-12-2003 in the daily Jonakantha published notification that there was a mistake as to the name of the fathers of his vendor in the notification dated 10-12-2003 which is actually Md. Yiadul Hossain not Md. Hosen. The father of the plaintiffs sent some foul play that MA Hashem might have committed forgery by using scientific method and planted a fake person in the name of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza, with whom he entered into a baina-nama. In the meantime the lather of the plaintiffs having died and plaintiff got succession certificate and they again give power of attorney to Eastern Housing Ltd. on 11-2-2004 by plaintiffs Nos.1 to 3, on 26-2-2004 by plaintiff No. 4 and on 1-3-2004 by plaintiff No. 5. The actual price of the suit plot is more than taka 20 crores and this plot has been shown in the bainanam dated 29-12-2002 in favour of defendant No.1 to be sold at Taka one crore sixty five lacs and defendant filed Title Suit No. 51 of 2004 against the said fake Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza for Specific Performance of Contract. These plaintiffs wanted to add in the aforesaid Title Suit No. 51 of 2004 as per provision of Order 1, rule 10 of the Code of Civil Procedure and through lawyer find that summons of the aforesaid suit was received by Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of Mirpur on 29-3-2004. Plaintiffs through their lawyers obtained all the papers produced before the Court by defendant No.1 in Title Suit No. 51 of 2004 and astonished to find that bainama and other deeds relating to allotment of the said property were prepared so masterly that it is difficult to find as to which one is true, real and original and which one is forged. The entire documents of Title Suit 51 of 2004 are product of forgery and address of defendant No. 1 as given in that suit of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza on enquiry by this plaintiffs was found that lie did not live there. These plaintiffs filed succession certificate case No. 439 of 2004 for the movable properties i.e. money left by their father Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza and got order on 18-5-2004. On the strength of that succession certificate to the very knowledge of defendant Nos.1 to 4 plaintiffs got the monies of their father's. In Title Suit No. 51 of 2004 upto the High Court Division their case is that they are not the heirs of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of Mirpur but the heirs of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of 157 Baro Moghbazar and thereafter they filed written statements in the aforesaid suit. The power of attorney holder of these plaintiffs on 14-2-2006 went to defendant No.1 of the instant suit, plaintiff of Title Suit No. 51 of 2004 but defendant No.1 of the instant suit, plaintiff of Title Suit No. 51 of 2004 was not amenable to the approach of power of attorney holder of the plaintiffs and declared that he will continue with the suit for Specific Performance of Contract. Since there are two fake Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza's i.e. defendant Nos. 2 and 3 who creating cloud by claiming the suit property plaintiff pray for declaration that they being heirs of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza of 157, Baro Moghbazar have title and to protect their properties, they filed the instant suit with the aforesaid prayers. 

 121. At the time of trial plaintiffs led the evidences to prove their case and they examined as many as 5 PWs PW 1 Nasiruddin Khan, PW 2 Shamima Zaman, PW 3 Shahin Rahman, PW 4 Md. Abdul Quiyum and PW 5 Md. Arifur Rahman. Plaintiff to prove the case produced some documents in the Court and marked as exhibits, exhibit 1 authorisation letter of Eastern Housing, exhibit 2 dated 11-2-2004 power of attorney, exhibit 3 series are power of Attorneys dated 24-2-2004 and 01-3-2004, Exhibit-4 series are Matriculation certificate, Intermediate certificate, Engineer Part-I and part II certificate original copy for the year 1946, 1948, 1950 respectively, Exhibit-5 domicile certificate original copy dated 17-1-1952, Exhibit-6 deed Nos. 9847 and 6 (Ka) deed Nos. 9849 dated 28-9-1957 certified copy compared with original copy, Exhibit-7 deed No.31901 dated 17-8-1979 certified copy compared with original, Exhibit-8 approved residential plan of 157 Bara Moghbazar, Exhibit-9 voter list ID card No. 44100, 16540310234 dated 08-8-1999 and 9 (Ka) passport M-0510358 dated 03-12-96 in original of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza, Exhibit-10 series higher training certificates of Canada Government, original letter of promotion Exhibit-11 series original certificates as Assistant Engineer and letter of promotion, Exhibit-12 series letter of allotment in original of suit plot and installment receipt in original, Exhibit-13 series 5 original installment deposit receipt of the National Bank of Pakistan showing deposit money to DIT paid by the Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza, Exhibit-14 possession hand over letter dated 07-4-1962 by DIT to Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza, Exhibit-15 lease deed in original copy dated 01-8-1962 in favour of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza father of the plaintiffs and 15 (Ka) and 15 (Kha) are the signature of attesting witnesses. Exhibit-16 original copy of approved plan for the suit plot, exhibit 16 (Ka) is the permission of DIT. Exhibit-17 is the sanction letter of Housing Building Finance Corporation, exhibit 17 (ka) mortgage deed being No. 9022 dated 17-5-1967, Exhibit-18 series 10 copies deed of agreement for lease and rent agreement in respect of suit house, Exhibit-19 series Gas bill book, WASA demand notice, the taxes receipts of city corporation, exhibit 20 series are the assessment form, Tax and rent receipts, Exhibit-21 series copies of rent receipts, certified copy of RS record Exhibit-22, Exhibit-23 and 23 (Ka) are the Memorandum & Articles of Association, Exhibit-24 series are yearly report of Uttara Bank, Application receipt copy of Rajuk for approval of Rajuk for converting the suit plot residential to commercial plot is exhibit 25, the approval letter of RAJUK converting residential to commercial plot Exhibit-26, Exhibit-27 is the certified copy of power of attorney being No. 15902 dated 21-12-03 with photo executated by Engineer Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza in his life time in favour of Eastern Housing, exhibit 28 is the original received copy of RAJUK by which original power of attorney has been deposited to Rajuk office, Exhibit-29 series are the commercially approved plan copies of RAJUK, Exhibit-30 series are the notices dated 18-11-03 published in the Daily Inquilab, Janakantha, and the Observer and the protest notices dated 30-12-03, exhibit 31 series are the protest notice by which MA Hashem denied the existence of father of the plaintiffs, Exhibit-31(Kha) dated 2-2-04 is the copy of death certificate, exhibit 32 is the death certificate, Exhibit-33 is the notice dated 05-2-2004, Exhibit-34 is the certified copy of succession certificate issued in succession case being No. 439 of 2004 by Joint District Judge, 3rd Court, Dhaka. Exhibit 35 is the Photostat certified copies of Judgment of CR No.358 of 2004 and C.R.4608 of 2004 Exhibit-36 is the certified copy of plaint of T.S. 176 of 2004. Exhibit-37 is the pay bill of Shamsul Kabir Humayun Reza. Exhibit-38 is the Passport No. B-057985 dated 15-1-75.
